question: Find the display name of the user who posted the most popular (highest total view count) post that received a bounty vote of 100 in 2011 and also holds the 'Announcer' badge.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
JOIN votes AS v ON p."XCL_026" = v."XCL_067"
JOIN badges AS b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
WHERE v."XCL_068" = 10
  AND v."XCL_071" = 100
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', v."XCL_069") = '2011'
  AND b."XCL_003" = 'Announcer'
ORDER BY p."XCL_030" DESC
LIMIT 1;
